blocks.text: Sab aabi solutions mein H+ aur OH- ki concentrations itni kam hain ke unhen aasani se likhna aur hisab mein istemal karna mushkil hai. 1909 mein Danish biochemist Sorenson ne pH aur pOH ki istilahein (terms) pesh kin aur pH aur pOH ke paimane (scales) bane: pH = -log[H+] aur pOH = -log[OH-]. Neutral pani ke liye pH = -log(10^-7) = 7 aur pOH = 7, aur pH + pOH = 14. 25 degrees C par pH ki qeemat aam taur par 0 se 14 ke darmiyan hoti hai, agarche manfi pH aur 14 se zyada pH ke solutions bhi jane jate hain. Figure 9.1 kuch jani pehchani aabi solutions ki pH qeematein deti hai, jo aam solutions ki tezabi ya basic nau'iyat samajhne mein madad karti hai.

blocks.alt: Dohri nok wala teer: surkh (tezabi), safed (neutral), neela (basic); neeche pH 0-14, oopar [H3O+] 10^0 se 10^-14, Neutral 10^-7 par. Andar: HCl (1.0 M) pH 0.0, stomach acid pH 1.0-3.0, lemon juice pH 2.2-2.4, vinegar pH 2.4-3.4, carbonated water pH 3.9, beer pH 4.0-4.5, milk pH 6.4, blood pH 7.4, seawater pH 7.0-8.3, baking soda (0.1 M) pH 8.4, milk of magnesia pH 10.5, household ammonia pH 11.9, NaOH (1.0 M) pH 14.0.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Kuch aam cheezon ki pH values (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ek solution ka pH 9.2 hai; 25 degrees C par Kw nikalein. Pehle pOH: pOH = 14 - pH = 14 - 9.2 = 4.8. Phir antilog le kar concentrations: [H+] = 10^-pH = 10^-9.2, taqreeban 6.3 x 10^-10 M, aur [OH-] = 10^-pOH = 10^-4.8, taqreeban 1.6 x 10^-5 M. Aakhir mein Kw = [H+][OH-] = (6.3 x 10^-10) x (1.6 x 10^-5) = 1.008 x 10^-14, to is darja hararat par pani ka ionic product taqreeban 1.01 x 10^-14 hai. (Print pehle antilog ko '[OH-] = 10^-pH' likhti hai; yeh [H+] hai.)
Sample Problem 9.2: Kw se [OH-], pH aur pOH

25 degrees C par Kw = 1.0 x 10^-14 aur solution mein H+ ions ki concentration 1.0 x 10^-7 M hai. Kw = [H+][OH-] se, 1.0 x 10^-14 = (1.0 x 10^-7)[OH-], to [OH-] = 1.0 x 10^-14 / 1.0 x 10^-7 = 1.0 x 10^-7 M (print nateeja 1.0 x 10^-14 likhti hai). Phir pH = -log(1.0 x 10^-7) = 7 aur pOH = -log(1.0 x 10^-7) = 7.

blocks.prompt: Copper etching ka solution 0.30 M HNO3 hai. 25 degrees C par [H+], pH, [OH-] aur pOH nikalein (Quick Check 9.2c).
blocks.explanation: Nitric acid strong hai, to [H+] = 0.30 mol dm-3 aur pH = -log 0.30 = 0.52. [OH-] = Kw / [H+] = 1.0 x 10^-14 / 0.30 = 3.3 x 10^-14 mol dm-3, aur pOH = 14 - 0.52 = 13.48 (jo -log 3.3 x 10^-14 hai).

items: Sorenson (1909): pH = -log[H+], pOH = -log[OH-]; neutral pani pH = pOH = 7; 25 degrees C par pH + pOH = 14; pH aam taur par 0 se 14, agarche bahar ki qeematein bhi mumkin.
